title: Comfy Fighter Z
subtitle: Higgsfield Open Source Saga
footageDisclosure: All phone-style photographs are newly AI-generated fictional adults and a fictional environment. No real-person photographs, earlier session inputs, old game art or old audio are used. Actual generation footage is condensed and labeled. The new game contains six fighters, The Yard, and 22 generated audio clips.

scenes.title: Phone photos to playable fighters
scenes.narration: These fictional phone photos become Comfy Fighter Z: six anime fighters, one backyard arena, and a complete playable game. Here is the workflow.
onScreen: Phone-style reference → anime fighter → playable game

scenes.title: Open the factory
scenes.narration: Clone the repository, run npm ci, and install its custom nodes in your active ComfyUI instance. Restart ComfyUI and open the upload workflow. Cloud models need no local checkpoint downloads.

scenes.title: Invent the reference photos
scenes.narration: ComfyUI creates seven fresh phone-style references from text: six invented adults and a backyard. This demo uses no real photographs or identities.
onScreen: AI-generated fictional adults and environment • No real people

scenes.title: Upload the fictional references
scenes.narration: Choose Upload reference and attach each new photo to its fighter. Add the backyard to The Yard, leaving the other two environments disabled.
onScreen: 6 character slots • The Yard enabled • 2 environments disabled

scenes.title: Describe the game
scenes.narration: Describe each fighter, special move, and introduction line. Set one new output folder to keep generated art, sprites, voices, and music together. Keep character IDs stable throughout the whole build.
onScreen: One root directory • Character description • Special move • Intro tagline

scenes.title: Generate the complete bundle
scenes.narration: Run the cloud factory. This condensed recording shows actual generation: forty-nine new game images and twenty-two audio clips written to the shared folder.
onScreen: Condensed actual generation • 49 game images + 22 audio clips

scenes.title: Review identity and poses
scenes.narration: Compare each photo with its anime identity. Inspect every sheet for consistent outfits, complete hands and feet, and exactly one figure per pose.
onScreen: Phone reference → anime identity → 3 × 3 sprite sheet

scenes.title: Build with your own assets
scenes.narration: Load the folder in the browser builder. Assets dot JSON and audio dot JSON map everything. Customize names and accents; keep placeholders disabled.

scenes.title: Export the complete game
scenes.narration: Export a ZIP or directory: six fighters, one arena, one hundred sixty-two poses, and twenty-two audio clips. Start the included server.

scenes.title: Your next challenger
scenes.narration: Arrows move. A, S, D, and F attack. Play online, or build your own.
